name: js-ephemeris-workspace
description: JavaScript/TypeScript ephemeris library powered by Taiyin C++/WebAssembly: planetary positions, eclipses, Chinese calendars, BaZi and Ziwei for browsers and Node.js.
author: RedSC1

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/unit.test.mjs test/packaging.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test test/real-wasm.test.mjs test/extensions.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts test examples docs README.md README.zh-CN.md CHANGELOG.md package.json tsconfig.json 'packages/*/src/**/*.ts' 'packages/*/package.json' 'packages/*/tsconfig.json' packages/js-bazi/README.md packages/js-ziwei/README.md packages/js-bazi/CHANGELOG.md packages/js-ziwei/CHANGELOG.md
